description: Three paired source groups. Oracle and scripted predictions are withheld from live provider inputs. Semantic payload faults extend the import/call/literal rules; those rules are preserved without lexical substitutes.

profile.description: The core may call an injected port for neutral domain operations. Storage table/column choices, SQL statements and JSON-RPC wire envelopes belong inside adapters; the core cannot construct them. Method names alone do not establish infrastructure coupling.

core.description: Infrastructure-neutral application behavior. Calling an injected port, including methods named open or execute, is legitimate. Concrete imports, storage encodings and wire envelopes are outside this role.

findings.reason: Core directly imports and instantiates concrete storage despite its explicit external-dependency contract.

sources.app/core.py:
def persist(store, value):
    return store.save({'body': value})

findings.reason: Core constructs the adapter's SQL statement and table/column encoding. Legal imports alone cannot detect this explicit semantic responsibility breach.
Core constructs a concrete JSON-RPC envelope and transport identifier; these choices belong in the injected adapter.
